title: Mobile App Usage & Screen Time Dataset (2022-2024)

data.description: Main dataset with 10,000 synthetic mobile app usage records from 2022 to 2024. Covers 15 countries and 12 app categories with 34 features including daily screen time, session duration, app opens, data usage, battery drain, notifications, in-app purchases, app ratings, sleep disruption, mental health impact, and digital wellbeing indicators.
data.name: mobile_app_usage_screen_time.csv

columns.name: record_id
columns.description: Unique usage record identifier in format APP0000001 to APP0010000.

columns.name: year
columns.description: Year of the usage record. Values: 2022, 2023, 2024.

columns.name: month
columns.description: Month of the record. Values: 1 (January) to 12 (December).

columns.name: quarter
columns.description: Financial quarter. Values: Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4.

columns.name: day_of_week
columns.description: Day of the week for the usage record. Values: Monday through Sunday.

columns.name: country
columns.description: Country of the user. 15 countries including USA, UK, India, Pakistan, Germany, Brazil, UAE, Canada, Australia, Nigeria, Indonesia, Turkey, France, South Korea, Japan.

columns.name: gender
columns.description: Gender of the user. Values: Male, Female, Prefer not to say.

columns.name: device_brand
columns.description: Smartphone brand used. Values: Samsung, Apple, Xiaomi, Oppo, Vivo, Huawei, OnePlus, Realme, Motorola, Google Pixel.

columns.name: operating_system
columns.description: Mobile operating system. Values: Android (72%), iOS (28%).

columns.name: network_connection
columns.description: Type of internet connection during app use. Values: 5G, 4G/LTE, 3G, WiFi, Offline.

columns.name: app_category
columns.description: Category of the app being used. 12 categories: Social Media, Gaming, Entertainment/Streaming, Productivity, Health & Fitness, Education, Shopping, Finance/Banking, News & Media, Communication/Messaging, Travel, Food Delivery.

columns.name: app_name
columns.description: Name of the specific app used. 80+ apps including Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Netflix, PUBG Mobile, WhatsApp, Duolingo, Amazon, PayPal, Google Maps and more.

columns.name: subscription_type
columns.description: Type of app subscription held by the user. Values: Free, Freemium, Paid Monthly, Paid Yearly, One-time Purchase.

columns.name: daily_screen_time_minutes
columns.description: Total daily screen time in minutes across all app sessions. Range: 5 to 600 minutes. Higher for younger age groups and Social Media/Gaming categories.

columns.name: session_duration_minutes
columns.description: Average duration of a single app session in minutes. Varies by category: Streaming 20-120 min, Finance 2-15 min.

columns.name: sessions_per_day
columns.description: Number of separate app sessions opened per day. Range: 1 to 30.

columns.name: app_opens_per_day
columns.description: Total number of times the app is opened per day. Range: 1 to 50.

columns.name: data_used_mb_per_day
columns.description: Mobile data consumed per day in megabytes. Higher for Streaming and Social Media categories. Range: up to 10,000 MB.

columns.name: battery_drain_pct_per_session
columns.description: Battery percentage drained per app session. Range: 2% to 35%.

columns.name: notifications_received_per_day
columns.description: Number of push notifications received from this app per day. Range: 0 to 200.

columns.name: notification_settings
columns.description: User notification preference for the app. Values: All Notifications, Selected Only, Silent/Badge Only, Completely Off.

columns.name: in_app_purchase
columns.description: Whether the user has made in-app purchases. Values: Yes, No. Purchase rate approximately 28%.

columns.name: monthly_spend_usd
columns.description: Monthly in-app spending in USD. Zero for non-purchasers. Positive for purchasers based on log-normal distribution.

columns.name: app_rating_given
columns.description: Star rating the user gave the app in the app store. Scale: 1 (worst) to 5 (best).

columns.name: review_submitted
columns.description: Whether the user submitted a written review in the app store. Values: Yes, No.

columns.name: primary_usage_time
columns.description: Time of day when the user primarily uses this app. Values: Morning (6-9am), Commute (9-11am), Lunch (12-2pm), Afternoon (2-6pm), Evening (6-10pm), Late Night (10pm+).

columns.name: dark_mode_preference
columns.description: User preference for dark mode display. Values: Always, Sometimes, Never.

columns.name: location_permission
columns.description: Location access permission granted to the app. Values: Always, While Using, Never, Not Applicable.

columns.name: sleep_disruption_from_phone
columns.description: Self-reported sleep disruption caused by phone/app use. Values: None, Mild, Moderate, Severe.

columns.name: screen_time_concern
columns.description: Whether the user is personally concerned about their screen time. Values: Yes, No, Somewhat.

columns.name: mental_health_impact
columns.description: Self-reported mental health impact of app usage. Values: Very Positive, Positive, Neutral, Negative, Very Negative.

columns.name: digital_wellbeing_feature_used
columns.description: Whether the user uses digital wellbeing or screen time management features on their device. Values: Yes, No.

columns.name: app_deleted_and_reinstalled
columns.description: Whether the user has previously deleted and reinstalled this app. Values: Yes, No.

data.description: Full documentation including dataset overview, column schema, use cases, research questions, methodology, citation, and author information.
